text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I can feel the buzz in the stadium all the way from here!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The anticipation keeps building! As soon as we go out there, the crowd's excitement will burst out in waves of cheers!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's like I can already feel myself up on the stage! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: For sure! I'd love to get up there and wave a folding fan around!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Everyone's here to see us, after all! I have to show them my stuff!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to hit the accelerator!
